messages:
lina (Docs): Heads-up: we're publishing a docs + SDK plan to deprecate the `stream_mode` param in favor of `stream` to align naming across SDKs and the API. This came out of confusion in examples where some languages used `stream` and others `stream_mode`. Draft: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/901

ryan (Eng SDK): What is the exact user-visible behavior during the transition window?

lina (Docs): Server will accept both keys for 90 days. SDKs will add a backwards-compatible alias that accepts `stream_mode` and maps to `stream`. We'll call out removal date prominently in docs, changelog, and console.

tara (Product): Proposed timeline: announce tomorrow, SDK patches this week (semver patch with alias), enforcement removal 2026-07-01. Is that reasonable?

ryan (Eng SDK): Works for us if we can ship the alias + unit tests and a short migration utility in the repo. I'll drop a PR today.

henry (Security): Any security/compliance implications for Private deployments? If they pin SDK versions we need to ensure private packs include the patch.

chris (Platform): For Dedicated/Private we'll add a runtime compat toggle that keeps `stream_mode` accepted beyond enforcement for customers who need it temporarily. We won't enable it by default after enforcement unless they request it. Need Ops runbook for toggling.

lina (Docs): Good call. Add a short runbook blurb to the migration guide. Also adding FAQ entries for telemetry and eval impact.

docs-bot: PR 901 opened by lina 1:03 UTC 1 checks pending. CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/1298

ali (Customer Success): I'll prepare a short customer-facing blurb: "API/SDK param rename: `stream_mode` -> `stream`. Both accepted until July 1, 2026. See migration steps and FAQ." Want to coordinate dev docs with the email.

ryan (Eng SDK): Migration helper idea: tiny script that searches codebase and replaces common patterns. Example snippet to include in docs:
```
# python example
resp = client.generate(..., stream=True)
# old style
# resp = client.generate(..., stream_mode=True)
```
I'll add a linter rule to warn on `stream_mode` in examples and tests.

lina (Docs): Please also add a note about sample outputs changing for streaming vs non-streaming — show both in examples.

chris (Platform): We'll surface a console banner for the next 30 days pointing to the migration guide and show enforcement date. Also add a per-customer banner for Dedicated accounts.

henry (Security): Confirming telemetry naming: will we preserve metric keys? We need no-ops on alerting configs.

ryan (Eng SDK): Alias will map to the same internal metric tag `request.stream` so alerts remain stable. We'll include unit tests that validate metric emission.

lina (Docs): Action items: 1) ship SDK alias patch (ryan) 2) docs + migration guide (lina) 3) console + per-customer banners (chris) 4) customer comms (ali) 5) linter + grep in CI (ryan/mike) 6) Dedicated runtime toggle (chris). I'll update the PR with these tasks and assignees.

ali (Customer Success): If someone hits issues during migration contact cs-migration@redwood.dev. We'll keep a tracker for customers requesting extended compatibility windows.

lina (Docs): Great. I'll merge the doc PR after the SDK patch lands and then trigger the announcement. Thanks all. :partyparrot:
